name: Paul Brittain
biography: Originally from Chicago, where he got his start in improv and sketch comedy, Paul Brittain is an actor, writer, and comedian living in Los Angeles. He was a cast member on Saturday Night Live from 2010 - 2012 where he performed such characters and impressions as "Sex" Ed Vincent, Lord Cecil Wyndemere, James Franco, and Johnny Depp. He's appeared in the films Grown Ups 2, Hotel Transylvania, Hotel Transylvania 2, and Killing Gunther. His television credits include Trophy Wife, Hello Ladies, Kroll Show, Shrink,and Comedy Bang Bang. Paul recently created the podcast Mr. Write, which can be heard on Stitcher and Howl.Fm.
